summary: Bootstrap harvest depth: ADR files are now READ (title + status + Decision/Décision excerpt, capped at 20 newest, 600-char per excerpt) and emitted as decision-kind seeds with high confidence and the ADR file as related_path. MemorySeedKind extended with decision/constraint/trap, and seedToBootstrapSuggestion now routes those kinds to typed candidates (decision/outcome=pending, constraint/category=process, trap/severity=medium) instead of dropping them. Branch name, dirty-status warning and active-branch hotspot seeds removed from the persisted seed set — they were execution-context-volatile and invalidated the bootstrap cache on every dispatch; the live snapshot still carries them for display. tsc clean for both tsconfig.json and tsconfig.test.json; new test file plus bootstrap-core / bootstrap-command / bootstrap-need-assessment all green.
commits: 64e0747 feat(bootstrap): read ADRs, emit typed seeds, drop transient facts (pln#557 stp_d6bb1d95)
7fe898c test(bootstrap): cover ADR harvest depth + typed seeds + transient exclusion (pln#557 stp_d6bb1d95)
